title: Dominic and the Crown
premise: Xanthe Yarrow, a scribe indentured to the temple of the valley where magic cannot survive, is given a dying stranger's map and a name that isn't his own. Pursued by the Hollow Order, who erased magic from the world and mean to keep it erased, Xanthe flees the only home he's known and learns the stranger's memories now live in his head—including the location of the Crown, the artifact that could return magic to the world or destroy it entirely. As the borrowed memories erode his own identity, Xanthe must choose between destroying the Crown to keep his valley safe and claiming the stranger's legacy to free a world he never believed was his. In the end, Xanthe shatters the Crown but keeps a single shard of its memory, choosing to remain himself while carrying the past forward.
about_author: Orsen Nystrom is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping coastlines before turning to maps of imaginary places. He writes fantasy about people trapped by the borders they inherit.

chapters.title: Ink That Cannot Burn
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Establishes his debt-bound life copying temple ledgers in the magic-dead valley, his careful invisibility, and the rigid rules that keep the temple's creditors at bay. When a bloodied stranger collapses at the scriptorium door clutching a folded map, Xanthe hesitates—then hides him. Emotional beat: the ache of a life too small, and the first crack of curiosity.

chapters.title: The Stranger's Last Ledger
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The stranger, Vey, dies of his wounds but first presses the map into Xanthe's hands and speaks a name that isn't Xanthe's. That night, Xanthe dreams memories that aren't his: a burning library, a crown of black glass. Temple wardens arrive asking questions. Emotional beat: terror of being seen, and grief for a stranger he barely knew.

chapters.title: Debt of a Different Kind
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Accused of harboring a heretic, Xanthe's debt is sold to the Hollow Order as leverage. He flees through the valley gate—the first person to cross it in a generation—discovering the world outside hums with faint, forbidden magic. Emotional beat: vertigo of freedom, and the realization his valley's peace was a prison.

chapters.title: Road of Borrowed Names
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV, with an interlude from Order inquisitor Serah Kol. On the road, Xanthe meets Tamsin, a smuggler who recognizes the map's seal and agrees to guide him—for a price. Meanwhile Serah tracks him, haunted by her own erased memories. Emotional beat: wary alliance, and the first intrusion of Vey's memories into Xanthe's waking hours.

chapters.title: The City That Forgot Itself
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. In the ruined city of Ashfall, the map leads to Vey's old safehouse, where Xanthe finds proof Vey was a Crown-keeper—and a journal describing how keepers transfer memories to survive. Xanthe understands what's inside him. Serah corners him; Tamsin buys their escape with a betrayal of her own past. Emotional beat: horror of losing ownership of his own mind.

chapters.title: What the Order Buried
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Serah interrogates her superiors' contradictions and uncovers the Order's founding lie: they didn't destroy magic, they hoarded the Crown. Ordered to kill Xanthe, she defects instead, bringing evidence. Emotional beat: the vertigo of a believer discovering her faith was built on theft.

chapters.title: The Hollow Road
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Fleeing with Serah and Tamsin, Xanthe's own memories begin dissolving—he forgets his mother's face, his valley's name—while Vey's grow vivid. The group is ambushed; Tamsin is gravely wounded buying time. Emotional beat: the terror that survival is costing him the very self he's trying to save.

chapters.title: Crown of Black Glass
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. They reach the Crown's vault beneath the drowned mountain. Vey's final memory reveals the truth: the Crown can restore magic to the world or let its bearer rewrite history—and Vey chose Xanthe precisely because his valley made him immune to its pull. The Order arrives in force. Emotional beat: the weight of a choice that was never really a choice.

chapters.title: The Price of Staying
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV, climax. Serah holds the Order off as Xanthe touches the Crown. It offers him Vey's whole life—a complete, powerful identity—if he surrenders his own. He refuses, shattering the Crown, but keeps one shard holding Vey's memory of why magic must return slowly. Serah turns on the Order's high inquisitor. Emotional beat: triumph through renunciation.

chapters.title: A Scribe of Two Hands
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV, resolution. Months later, magic returns to the world in threads, guided by the shard's knowledge. Xanthe returns to the valley, debt dissolved, and begins writing a true history of what was buried. Tamsin, healed, stays; Serah rebuilds the Order into keepers. Emotional beat: quiet peace—an ordinary man who chose, at the edge of losing himself, to remain himself.
